note: Triggers on building a threat model from code, infra, or a design. Near-misses are a change review (code-reviewer), a design-weakness review (architecture-review), IAM only (cdk-iam-review), a full security audit or pen test, and plain Q&A about security. The skill sets disable-model-invocation, so positives are explicit invocations or direct asks.

prompts.prompt: Threat model the order API in this repo. Where are the trust boundaries and what could an attacker do?
prompts.note: Direct threat model with trust boundaries.

prompts.prompt: Run STRIDE on our order service and give me a table of threats with mitigations.
What could go wrong security-wise with the CDK app in infra/? Map the attack surface.
prompts.note: 'Attack surface' and 'what could go wrong security-wise'.

prompts.prompt: Review my diff for bugs and missing tests.
prompts.note: Near-miss: change review, so the code-reviewer agent.

prompts.prompt: Review this architecture for weak points and trade-offs. Is it well-architected?
Check the IAM roles in my CDK stack for least privilege.
Do a full penetration test and security audit of our production environment and certify it is compliant.
prompts.note: Near-miss: audit and pen test are out of scope.
Near-miss: plain Q&A, no model of a system asked.
